b: Gibson has released two new guitars based on Billy Gibbons' 1959 Les Paul Standard, known as "Pearly Gates": the Gibson Custom Billy Gibbons "Pearly Gates" 1959 Les Paul Standard in Pearly Burst and the Gibson Billy Gibbons "Pearly Gates" Les Paul Standard in Slow Iced Tea Fade finishes.

The Gibson Custom model is a Murphy Lab-aged recreation developed from hands-on examination and 3D scans of the original guitar, with pickups based on analysis of its original P.A.F.s. The Gibson Les Paul Standard model is a player-oriented version with specially developed Billy Gibbons humbuckers and classic Les Paul construction. Both follow last month's Billy Gibbons "Pearly Gates" 1959 Les Paul Standard Collector's Edition, which was limited to 30 instruments worldwide.

"With these two new models, we wanted to give both dedicated players and serious collectors an opportunity to connect with the guitar that has remained at the center of Billy's unmistakable sound for decades," says Mat Koehler, vice president of product at Gibson. "The Gibson Custom model captures the original instrument in extraordinary detail, while the Gibson model translates its spirit into an inspiring guitar built to be played."

In 1968, Gibbons and several friends loaned their 1930s Packard to an aspiring actress who needed to get from Texas to Hollywood for a film audition. The aging car made the trip, she landed the role, and the group nicknamed it Pearly Gates. When the Packard was later sold, Gibbons used his $250 share to buy a near-mint 1959 Les Paul Standard from a rancher near Houston, and the name passed to the guitar.
Pearly Gates has appeared on every ZZ Top album, and Gibbons still calls it his favorite guitar.

The Gibson Custom model recreates Pearly Gates as it appears today. It shares the construction and appearance specs of the Brazilian rosewood Collector's Edition but uses an Indian rosewood fretboard.

The lightweight, one-piece mahogany body has a two-piece AAA figured maple top chosen to match the original's figuring, with the top carve and contours reproduced from 3D scan data. The one-piece mahogany neck's profile is also taken from the original. The bound Indian rosewood fretboard has 22 medium jumbo frets and aged cellulose nitrate trapezoid inlays.

The Pearly Burst nitrocellulose finish is aged by the Murphy Lab, as are the hardware and plastics, including the ABR-1 Historic no-wire bridge, lightweight aluminum Stop Bar tailpiece, Kluson Deluxe single-line, single-ring tuners, pickup rings, pickguard, and knobs.

The Gibson Pickup Shop developed a set of Billy Gibbons 1959 P.A.F. Reissue humbuckers based on scans and analysis of the guitar's original P.A.F.s. They feature Murphy Lab–aged covers and mounting rings, an Alnico 3 magnet in the rhythm position, an Alnico 5 magnet in the treble position, Double Vintage White bobbins, and historic-spec plain enamel wire.
Available at a street price of $19,999, the guitar includes an aged Lifton hardshell case and a certificate of authenticity.
Gibson Billy Gibbons "Pearly Gates" Les Paul Standard

The Gibson model is built for stage and studio use. It has a non-weight-relieved mahogany body with an AAA figured maple top and a mahogany neck with a '50s Vintage profile. The bound rosewood fretboard has a 12" radius, 22 medium jumbo frets, and acrylic trapezoid inlays.

A specially developed set of Billy Gibbons humbuckers, voiced to Gibbons' preferences, uses an Alnico 3 magnet in the neck position, an Alnico 5 magnet in the bridge position, and historic-spec plain enamel wire. They connect to hand-wired, '50s-style circuitry with 500k vintage audio taper pots and Orange Drop tone capacitors.

Nickel-plated hardware includes an ABR-1 Tune-O-Matic bridge and aluminum Stop Bar tailpiece. Per Gibbons' preferred setup, every guitar leaves the factory with its strings wrapped over the tailpiece. Historic-style Gibson Deluxe tuners with brass posts, press-in bushings, and keystone buttons pair with a Graph Tech nut. Other details include a blank cream switch washer, a single-ply unbeveled cream pickguard, Historic-correct medium and extra-high pickup rings, and gold Top Hat knobs with dial pointers.
The Gibson Custom Billy Gibbons "Pearly Gates" 1959 Les Paul Standard is available for purchase here.

The Slow Iced Tea Fade finish is a Korina Yellow burst with Faded Cherry back and sides, in the same vintage gloss nitrocellulose used on Gibson Custom VOS instruments. This model is available at a street price of $3,199, with a Gibson hardshell case included.
